🌿 Amura Wellness Journey

Your personal phase-by-phase meal plan — built to grow with every phase

What is the Clean Eating phase?

While you're waiting for your full prescription, you start on the Clean Eating (CE) phase — an anti-inflammatory diet that cuts out known inflammatory foods. Many people with a high inflammatory load find it very difficult to jump straight into a weight-loss phase, so this stage comes first.

Excess water retention can come down to a certain extent during this phase. No weight loss is expected yet — this is about lowering inflammation, not the scale.

Where Clean Eating sits in the bigger Amura protocol

  1. CE — Clean Eating (you are here) — preparatory / anti-inflammatory phase
  2. V1 — Detox phase
  3. V2 — add back dairy and animal products
  4. V3 — add back nuts and seeds
  5. V4 — add back all nightshade vegetables
  6. V5 — add back cereals and fruits
  7. V6 — add back dals, legumes and pulses
  8. Maintenance — hold your target weight long-term

Each of these will get its own tab here once its details are shared — this page is built to grow with you.

What comes after Clean Eating

Once you've procured the recommended nutrients, protein powder, chia seeds and psyllium husk, you'll be ready for the Detox phase (V1) — typically an ~850 kcal/day diet. It sounds intense, but it's designed so you'll actually feel too full to finish a day's chart as your body settles into ketosis. For the first two weeks it's built from vegetables considered safe for most people, plus protein meals, to reduce inflammatory messenger molecules in your system.

After that two-week wash-off, foods get reintroduced one at a time (V2–V6), in escalating order of intolerance risk. If you react to something, you drop it, return to already-tested foods for 2–3 days, then try the next item. Around V3, fasting gets introduced gradually. Once you reach your target weight, Maintenance teaches you how to hold it — while still avoiding your personal intolerant foods to keep inflammation low.

Subscription note: the initial program runs 90 days from day one of Clean Eating, renewable monthly after.

🚫 To avoid in Clean Eating

  • Wheat & wheat products
  • Milk
  • Sugar
  • Dals
  • Fruits
  • Egg yolk
  • Packaged foods
  • Soy & soy products
  • Corn & corn products
  • Peanuts & cashewnuts
  • Dried fruits (dates, raisins, apricots)
  • Tender coconut & coconut water
  • Almonds (personal exclusion)
  • Pistachios (personal exclusion)

📌 Personal note: peanuts, cashews, almonds and pistachios are excluded across every recipe and snack in this plan (almonds/pistachios aren't part of the official CE protocol restrictions, but they're off the menu here by personal preference). Substituted with walnuts, macadamia, sunflower or pumpkin seeds instead. This exclusion carries forward into every future phase added to this page.

✅ Oils suggested

  • Ghee
  • Butter
  • Olive oil
  • Coconut oil
  • Sesame oil
  • Mustard oil
  • Avocado oil

📋 Other rules

  • Drink 3 litres of water a day
  • Eat within a 12-hour window
  • Dinner should be carbohydrate-free
  • Log your empty-stomach weight every morning
  • On diabetic meds? Log fasting blood sugar every morning
  • On BP meds? Log blood pressure every morning
  • Body measurements once a week
  • Follow a regular sleep pattern — aim for 7–9 hours

😅 Possible challenges (not everyone gets these)

Carb withdrawal — mild headache, tiredness. Lime juice with salt helps (skip salt if hypertensive).
Irregular bowel movement — usually settles within a couple of days.
Sleep pattern changes — may take longer to fall asleep at first; settles soon.
Light body pain — a tablespoon of ghee can help.

🍬 For craving control

  • Brush your teeth
  • Chew a clove or cardamom
  • Distract yourself
  • Take a short walk
  • Don't compromise on protein

All cravings pass in about 20 minutes 😁

💧 Help with carb withdrawal

Take the lime juice with salt drink twice a day, around 11 AM and 3 PM — this helps with carb-withdrawal symptoms. Sip it slowly over 10–15 minutes; gulping it down can cause sudden loose stools.

This is now scheduled automatically on every day of your plan (Days 1–14) in the Daily Meal Plan tab.

🍽️ Foods to eat, by meal

Breakfast

  • Egg whites, any form (masala omelette, cheese omelette, boiled, poached, burji)
  • Ragi dosa / sprouted moong dal dosa with chutney (except peanut chutney)
  • Ragi or oats porridge (made in water, add coconut milk)
  • Chia seed pudding (soaked in water, add coconut milk)
  • Puttu with coconut
  • Quinoa / sabudana upma
  • Ven pongal (made with rice and coconut)
  • Kerala appam / neer dosa / pathiri / idiyappam
  • Protein smoothie
  • Poha without peanuts

Lunch

  • Rice / quinoa / millets / bajra / jowar / buckwheat rotis
  • Egg burji / gravy
  • Pepper / lemon / garlic / jeera rasams without dals
  • Kofta curry
  • Vatha kuzhambu / poondu kuzhambu / puli kuzhambu / mor kuzhambu / kara kuzhambu / erissery / theeyal / avial
  • Coconut rice / lemon rice / tamarind rice / tomato rice / biryani / coriander rice
  • Any sabzi including potato (excluding corn and soya)
  • Curries with sprouted white/black chana, moong dal, rajma
  • Curd / buttermilk
  • Homemade pickles

Dinner

  • Paneer / eggs
  • Baked / boiled / roasted / raw vegetables
  • Soups (no corn flour, no soy or other sauces)

Snacks

  • Cucumber / carrot
  • Walnuts / macadamia / sunflower / pumpkin seeds (no peanuts, cashews, almonds or pistachios)
  • Lime juice with salt
  • Black tea / black coffee / green tea
  • Sprouted legume sundal
  • Unprocessed cheeses (mozzarella, cheddar, feta, ricotta, parmesan, gouda)
  • Makhana

🛒 Items to buy before you start

  • Whey protein (unflavoured) — buy the smallest size first to check tolerance
  • Chia seeds (unflavoured)
  • Psyllium husk (unflavoured)

Try the whey protein drink and the fiber drink on an empty stomach, once each, before diving in — just to confirm you tolerate them well. Sip fiber drinks slowly over 10–15 minutes; gulping can cause loose stools.

🌱 How to sprout dals at home

Soak overnight, then sprout: white chana, black chana, moong, lobia, masoor, moth bean, rajma, urad — all in whole form with the skin intact. Use them for breakfast or lunch; avoid at dinner since they carry carbs too.

Day 0 Aug 5, 2026 · Wed
Kick-off prep day

🌙 Everything to do before Day 1 starts

  • Do the big grocery shop: paneer/curd/egg whites, ragi/jowar/quinoa flours & grains, chia seeds, psyllium husk, whey protein (try a test dose on an empty stomach today). See the new 🛒 Weekly Grocery List tab for the exact Week 1 shopping list.
  • Soaking moong dal + oats for Day 3's Oats Porridge is not needed yet — but check each day's "prep the night before" note the evening prior.
  • Wash and prep sprouting dals you plan to use across the two weeks (moong, horse gram, lentils) — sprouting takes 8-24 hrs so start early batches now if you like.
  • Clear out wheat, milk, sugar, dals, soy, corn, peanuts/cashews, dried fruits and tender coconut from your immediate reach.
  • Stock the approved oils: ghee, butter, olive, coconut, sesame, mustard, avocado.
  • Weigh yourself (empty stomach) and take body measurements as your baseline.

💧 Fibre drink — have this twice today, around 11 AM & 3 PM

From your doctor's validation call: psyllium husk + chia seeds, helps with carb-withdrawal symptoms (mild headache, tiredness). Sip slowly, don't gulp.

Serves 125 kcal (estimated) / servDoctor's validation call + Amura plan docx
Ingredients
  • Psyllium husk – 2 tsp
  • Chia seeds – 1 tsp
  • Water – 1 glass
Method
  1. Mix psyllium husk and chia seeds into a glass of water; stir well and let it sit briefly to thicken slightly.
  2. Sip slowly over 10-15 minutes — don't gulp it down, as that can cause sudden loose stools.
  3. Have this twice a day, around 11 AM and 3 PM, to help with carb-withdrawal symptoms.
  4. Optional (confirmed OK on the validation call): a squeeze of lemon juice and a small pinch of salt can be added if you'd like.

Skip if you're hypertensive or on BP medication — check with your doctor.

💧 Fibre drink — have this twice today, around 11 AM & 3 PM

From your doctor's validation call: psyllium husk + chia seeds, helps with carb-withdrawal symptoms (mild headache, tiredness). Sip slowly, don't gulp.

Serves 125 kcal (estimated) / servDoctor's validation call + Amura plan docx
Ingredients
  • Psyllium husk – 2 tsp
  • Chia seeds – 1 tsp
  • Water – 1 glass
Method
  1. Mix psyllium husk and chia seeds into a glass of water; stir well and let it sit briefly to thicken slightly.
  2. Sip slowly over 10-15 minutes — don't gulp it down, as that can cause sudden loose stools.
  3. Have this twice a day, around 11 AM and 3 PM, to help with carb-withdrawal symptoms.
  4. Optional (confirmed OK on the validation call): a squeeze of lemon juice and a small pinch of salt can be added if you'd like.

What is the V1 (Detox / Wash-off) phase?

V1 follows straight on from Clean Eating and runs for 14 days. It's a therapeutic ~850 kcal/day diet — it sounds intense, but it's designed so you'll actually feel too full to finish a day's chart as your body settles into ketosis. It's built from vegetables considered safe for most people, plus simple protein meals, to reduce inflammatory messenger molecules in your system before foods start getting reintroduced one at a time in V2–V6.

Your daily template (same every day)

8:00 AM1 tbsp of a healthy fat (ghee, butter, olive/coconut/sesame/mustard/avocado oil) — can be stirred into black coffee
10:00 AMProtein meal
12:00 PMVegetable meal
2:00 PMProtein meal
4:00 PMVegetable meal
6:00 PMProtein meal
8:00 PMFibre drink

Plus 3 litres of water and 3 green teas across the day. Do not exceed 850 kcal/day.

Protein meal (as confirmed on your validation call): 10 AM — 1 scoop unflavoured whey/plant protein in 200ml water; 2 PM — 3 boiled egg whites; 6 PM — 1/2 scoop whey/plant protein in 100ml water. This 2-whey / 1-egg-white split (1.5 scoops total) is the confirmed daily pattern — don't swap all 3 slots to whey. The Recipe Library also keeps the egg-based protein-meal recipes on hand if you'd like a cooked-dish alternative on a given day (portion to a similar kcal figure).

Vegetable meal: a salad, soup, or cooked-vegetable dish made from the permitted vegetables (see Add/Remove Foods) — raw, steamed, sautéed or baked all count as "salad". Portioned toward ~200 kcal each where the recipe allows (see the kcal budget below).

The Daily Meal Plan below scales each day's vegetable-meal recipe toward the ~200 kcal figure (capped at a realistic 1–2x serving) — a few very low-kcal recipes (thin soups, pickles) won't reach 200 kcal even at 2x and are lower than this budget on those days; that's expected and not a portion you should force further.

💊 Your supplement schedule starts here

Per your prescription (No. QVS66P-A2) and validation call, the 14-supplement schedule begins on V1 Day 1 — not during Clean Eating. One new supplement is introduced each day; by V1 Day 14 you'll be on the full daily set. See each day's panel in the 📅 Daily Meal Plan tab below for exactly what's due and when.

What to expect, day by day

Day 1–3Slight headache & general tiredness
Day 4–6Higher fatigue, loss of hunger; breath, urine and sweat may smell different
Day 7Back to normal energy

This is the expected carb-withdrawal / ketosis pattern, not a sign something's wrong — see Do's & Don'ts for what helps.

Where V1 sits in the bigger Amura protocol

  1. CE — Clean Eating — preparatory / anti-inflammatory phase
  2. V1 — Detox / Wash-off (you are here)
  3. V2 — add back dairy and animal products
  4. V3 — add back nuts and seeds
  5. V4 — add back all nightshade vegetables
  6. V5 — add back cereals and fruits
  7. V6 — add back dals, legumes and pulses
  8. Maintenance — hold your target weight long-term

V2–V6 reintroduce one food group at a time, lowest to highest inflammatory risk. React to something? Drop it, return to already-tested foods for 2–3 days, then try the next item. This is also called a Reintroduction Diet — add back one new item a day, watch for symptoms (flushing, giddiness, headache, hives, itching, joint pain, nausea, rapid heartbeat, reflux, restlessness, skin rash/swelling, sleeplessness, stomach cramps, stuffy nose, vomiting, wheezing), and if any appear, note it, remove the item, and wait a couple of days before trying the next.

😅 Possible challenges & what helps

Carb withdrawal — mild headache, tiredness. Lime juice with salt helps (skip if hypertensive/on BP meds).
Irregular bowel movement — normal to go once every 3 days; alert the team if it's longer.
Light body pain — a tablespoon of ghee can help.
Sleep pattern changes — may take longer to fall asleep at first; settles soon.
Metallic taste in mouth — fat breaking down, ketones releasing. Normal.
Urine/sweat/breath smell different — same reason. Drink plenty of water.
Mild itching / rashes — you're detoxing. Hydrate well; a walk or sauna to sweat can help.
Lower blood pressure readings — lime juice with salt helps; alert the team if you're on BP medication.
Drop in blood sugar — alert the team if you're on diabetic medication.

Always tell the team promptly about any significant symptoms, trouble tolerating supplements, illness, or planned deviations.

📋 Other rules

  • Don't exceed 850 kcal/day
  • Drink 3 litres of water and 3 green teas a day
  • Skip any permitted vegetable that doesn't agree with you — the list isn't exhaustive, ask your health coach if unsure about one
  • A vegetable meal can be a salad (raw, steamed, sautéed or baked) or a soup — either counts
  • All spices can be used in salads/vegetable meals except green chilli and red chilli powder
  • Herbs, olive oil, apple cider vinegar and lime juice all work as dressings
  • Strenuous physical activity is best held off until V3 — check with your team before increasing exercise
  • If you need antibiotics or steroids during V1, temporarily switch back to Clean Eating until you've recovered, then resume V1

🍬 For craving control

  • Brush your teeth
  • Chew a clove or cardamom
  • Distract yourself
  • Take a short walk
  • Don't compromise on protein

All cravings pass in about 20 minutes 😁

What is the V2 (Reintroduction — Minimally Risky Items) phase?

V2 follows straight on from V1 and is a Reintroduction Diet: you keep eating everything already established as safe (V1's permitted vegetables, proteins, oils and seasonings), and every day add back exactly one new "minimally risky" food item — things like paneer, curd, cheeses, coconut, and a handful of milder vegetables. You watch for symptoms of intolerance for that one item before moving to the next. Still capped at ~850 kcal/day.

You can skip any item you already know doesn't agree with you, or simply don't like — skipping is fine and won't break the protocol.

Your daily template

8:00 AM1 tbsp of a healthy fat (organic butter/ghee or virgin coconut oil) — can go in black coffee
10:00 AMProtein meal
12:00 PMReintroduction — today's new food item*
2:00 PMProtein meal
4:00 PMVegetable meal
6:00 PMFibre drink
8:00 PMReintroduction — today's new food item*

Plus 3 litres of water and 3 green teas across the day. Do not exceed 850 kcal/day. *Along with the day's reintroduced item, you can freely add any amount of already-established safe foods.

Protein & vegetable choices are the same as V1 — 10 AM 1 scoop whey/plant protein, 2 PM 3 boiled egg whites, 4 PM a vegetable meal from your permitted list. (V2 drops V1's third, 6 PM protein slot and second vegetable meal to make room for the two reintroduction slots.)

🔢 How each day's kcal budget was worked out

Since each reintroduced food has a different calorie density (per the V2 diet list — see Add/Remove Foods), the exact numbers shift day to day, but the formula is fixed: 116 kcal healthy fat + 110 kcal whey (10 AM) + 51 kcal egg whites (2 PM) + ~25 kcal fibre drink + today's reintroduction item (split into two equal halves across 12 PM and 8 PM) + a vegetable meal at 4 PM scaled to use up whatever's left of the 850 kcal cap (floored, never rounded up over the cap). This is a computed judgment call on our part, not something from your source material verbatim — please sanity-check a day or two against how you're actually finding it.

All 14 supplements from your V1 schedule stay active every day of V2 (introduction is already complete by V1 Day 14) — see each day's panel below, or the Daily Log, for the full grouped-by-time list.

Where V2 sits in the bigger Amura protocol

  1. CE — Clean Eating — preparatory / anti-inflammatory phase
  2. V1 — Detox / Wash-off
  3. V2 — add back dairy & a few minimally-risky vegetables (you are here)
  4. V3 — add back nuts and seeds
  5. V4 — add back all nightshade vegetables
  6. V5 — add back cereals and fruits
  7. V6 — add back dals, legumes and pulses
  8. Maintenance — hold your target weight long-term

🔁 What is a Reintroduction Diet?

A reintroduction diet is used to find out if you're intolerant to any food items. You start by eating food known to be safe for most people. Then, every day, you add back one new item (not more) that's known to be a bit riskier.

If an item brings on symptoms of intolerance, note it in a journal, remove the item from your menu, wait a couple of days for the symptoms to wash off, then try the next item.

⚠️ Symptoms of food intolerance to look for

Flushing of skin
Reflux
Giddiness
Restlessness
Headache
Skin rash
Hive
Skin swelling
Irritability
Sleeplessness
Itching
Stomach cramps
Jitters
Stuffy nose
Joint pain
Vomiting
Nausea
Wheezing
Rapid heartbeat

Note any of these in a journal, remove that item, wait a couple of days for symptoms to clear, then move on to the next item.

📋 Other rules

  • Don't exceed 850 kcal/day
  • Drink 3 litres of water and 3 green teas a day
  • Introduce exactly one new item per day — not more
  • You can include any amount of your already-established safe foods alongside the day's new item
  • Skip any item you already know doesn't agree with you, or don't like
  • Protein, vegetable and seasoning choices are the same as V1
  • Note: no yogurt/buttermilk/coconut milk carried over as "already safe" from before — they're each being tested fresh on their own day in this list
